title: Dennis Greger - The Procedurality of Reality TV Design - An Overview
speaker: Dennis Greger
talk_title: The Procedurality of Reality TV Design - An Overview
description: Earlier speakers have already established that Reality TV is a roguelike, now to the question of how to make your roguelike more like Reality TV. A few simple techniques combine to infinitely interesting emergent situations depending on the players input. But for Reality TV designers, that�s only half of the job, you also have to take those situations and turn into meaningful tv entertainment. Prepare to be challenged to add social and narrative systems design to your projects.
